state_definition: ala2_common.CORE_BOXES_DEG / core_labels / transition_based_assignment at OBS_INTERVAL_PS = 1 ps
assignment: transition-based (last core visited); leading non-core frames dropped
estimator: deeptime MaximumLikelihoodMSM(reversible=True) on the largest strongly connected count set

bootstrap.replicate_policy: replicates whose largest connected set differs from the full estimate's are EXCLUDED (counted in n_boot_excluded_active_set_mismatch); replicates with an infinite timescale are dropped (n_boot_valid)
bootstrap.ci_valid_rule: at most 5% of the replicates lost

tba_convergence.rule: 95% percentile CI of the paired bootstrap ratio t2(tau_i)/t2(tau_j) contains 1, or t2(tau_i) within 10% of t2(tau_j), for every larger lag tau_j (tau > t2 kept; invalid-CI lags left out); tau_i >= 0 ps

shoot_lag.source: converged core-start t2 with a passing core-start CK (95% percentile CI of the paired bootstrap ratio t2(tau_i)/t2(tau_j) contains 1, or t2(tau_i) within 10% of t2(tau_j), for every larger lag tau_j (tau > t2 kept; invalid-CI lags left out); tau_i >= 10 ps; and the core-start CK at that lag passes (pass = true))
shoot_lag.rule: 95% percentile CI of the paired bootstrap ratio t2(tau_i)/t2(tau_j) contains 1, or t2(tau_i) within 10% of t2(tau_j), for every larger lag tau_j (tau > t2 kept; invalid-CI lags left out); tau_i >= 10 ps; and the core-start CK at that lag passes (pass = true)
shoot_lag.t2_only_note: the t2 rule alone, without the CK condition (the pre-2026-10-02 shooting lag)
shoot_lag.tol_only_note: same rule without the paired-ratio clause (relative tolerance only), CK condition kept
shoot_lag.why_min_lag: shots shorter than ~10 observation intervals from core frames almost never reach another core (transitions pass through the non-core bridge), so core-start T(tau) is dominated by the short-tau bias rather than the barrier-crossing kinetics

msm.estimator: deeptime MaximumLikelihoodMSM(reversible=True) on the largest strongly connected count set
msm.note: transition_matrix = reversible MLE (use for ITS / populations); transition_matrix_row_normalised = C_ij / sum_j C_ij (design-independent; 14b compares THIS)
msm.lag_source: converged TBA ITS (95% percentile CI of the paired bootstrap ratio t2(tau_i)/t2(tau_j) contains 1, or t2(tau_i) within 10% of t2(tau_j), for every larger lag tau_j (tau > t2 kept; invalid-CI lags left out); tau_i >= 0 ps)

ck_test.criterion: diag(T(tau)^k) inside [2.5,97.5]% bootstrap interval of diag(T_est(k tau)) +/- 0.01, k geometric up to max(5, ceil(2 t2 / tau))

core_start.definition: C_ij(tau) = #{t : raw core label at t = i (frame INSIDE core i), TBA label at t+tau = j}; the quantity estimated by 14b FixedLag shots launched from core frames and labelled by the last core visited (seeded with the start core)

convergence.rule: 95% percentile CI of the paired bootstrap ratio t2(tau_i)/t2(tau_j) contains 1, or t2(tau_i) within 10% of t2(tau_j), for every larger lag tau_j (tau > t2 kept; invalid-CI lags left out); tau_i >= 0 ps

msm.estimator: deeptime MaximumLikelihoodMSM(reversible=True) on the largest strongly connected count set
msm.note: transition_matrix = reversible MLE (use for ITS / populations); transition_matrix_row_normalised = C_ij / sum_j C_ij (design-independent; 14b compares THIS)
msm.lag_source: converged core-start t2 with a passing core-start CK (95% percentile CI of the paired bootstrap ratio t2(tau_i)/t2(tau_j) contains 1, or t2(tau_i) within 10% of t2(tau_j), for every larger lag tau_j (tau > t2 kept; invalid-CI lags left out); tau_i >= 10 ps; and the core-start CK at that lag passes (pass = true))

ck_test.criterion: diag(T(tau)^k) inside [2.5,97.5]% bootstrap interval of diag(T_est(k tau)) +/- 0.01, k geometric up to max(5, ceil(2 t2 / tau))

contract_14b.compare_against: core_start.msm.transition_matrix_row_normalised (with its CIs) at shoot_lag_ps; the reversible transition_matrix is for ITS/populations only
contract_14b.lag_grid_rule: 14b fixes tau on the contract grid ala2_common.SHOOT_LAG_GRID_PS (ruling R40); a shoot_lag_ps chosen on any other grid is diagnostic only
contract_14b.estimator: compare ROW-NORMALISED T_ij = C_ij / sum_j C_ij (design-independent). The reversible MLE (deeptime MaximumLikelihoodMSM(reversible=True) on the largest strongly connected count set) couples rows through detailed balance, so with 3 states it depends on the per-state number of shots (3.5-6 % on alphaL elements); use it for ITS only
contract_14b.propagator: LangevinMiddle, gamma = 0.1 / ps, 300 K, dt = 2 fs, fixed box (as ref_long.py)
